name: Tinker Town
summary: In Tinker Town, gnomes make a home in exile beneath Ironforge. After Gnomeregan fell, the district became the seat of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque's government and the Ironforge terminus of the Deeprun Tram.

sections.title: A Home in Exile
sections.body: Tinker Town shelters the gnomes who fled Gnomeregan. When troggs overran their high-tech city, Ironforge's dwarves opened their gates, setting aside a cavern that had housed dwarves and held the Deeprun Tram entrance. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and his council lead the refugees here. Around a massive spherical contraption, the gnomes have rebuilt a semblance of their civilization amid whirring gears, experimental alchemy, and gadgetry. Though cramped guests in a stone city, they remain determined to reclaim their subterranean homeland.

sections.title: Subway and Secrets
sections.body: Tinker Town connects Ironforge to Stormwind by tram. The district holds the Ironforge entrance to the Deeprun Tram, an engineering wonder that swiftly links the dwarven capital with Stormwind.

faq.q: Why are gnomes living in Ironforge instead of their own city?
aliases: why do gnomes live in ironforge
faq.answer: Gnomeregan fell when primitive troggs invaded, and the gnomes evacuated. They fought the troggs alone rather than burdening the Alliance during the Third War. King Magni Bronzebeard offered Ironforge as a sanctuary, where High Tinker Mekkatorque established a temporary capital in exile.

faq.q: What is the Deeprun Tram entrance doing here?
faq.answer: The Deeprun Tram connects Ironforge directly to Stormwind City. Gnomes and dwarves built it together, and its Ironforge terminus opens into Tinker Town, linking the two Alliance capitals with high-speed transit.

angles.text: As a gnome, Tinker Town is the heart of your people in exile. Amid clanking prototypes and fellow survivors, High Tinker Mekkatorque directs efforts to reclaim Gnomeregan.
For an engineer, Tinker Town is an essential stop in Ironforge, with specialized trainers, gadget vendors, and parts, as well as the Deeprun Tram.
